#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
cd "$(dirname "$0")"
CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath -ldflags="-s -w" -o app .

package main

import (
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func TestRun(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name, in, want string
	}{
		{"spec", "1 + 2 * 3
-7 / 2
(1 + 2
9223372036854775807 + 1
", "7
-3
error
error
"},
		{"rem sign", "-7 % 3
7 % -3
", "-1
1
"},
		{"min rem", "(-9223372036854775807 - 1) % -1
", "0
"},
		{"min div", "(-9223372036854775807 - 1) / -1
", "error
"},
		{"min neg", "-(-9223372036854775807 - 1)
", "error
"},
		{"min literal", "-9223372036854775808
", "error
"},
		{"mul overflow", "3037000500 * 3037000500
-3037000499 * 3037000499
", "error
-9223372030926249001
"},
		{"min mul", "(-9223372036854775807 - 1) * 1
(-9223372036854775807-1) * -1
", "-9223372036854775808
error
"},
		{"blank", "
 	 
5", "5
"},
		{"syntax", "1 +
abc
()
1 2
+1
)
1)
", "error
error
error
error
error
error
error
"},
		{"unary", "--5
2*-3
1 - -2
-(2+3)
", "5
-6
3
-5
"},
		{"deep", strings.Repeat("(", 100000) + "1" + strings.Repeat(")", 100000) + "
", "1
"},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			var sb strings.Builder
			if err := run(strings.NewReader(tt.in), &sb); err != nil {
				t.Fatal(err)
			}
			if got := sb.String(); got != tt.want {
				t.Errorf("got %q, want %q", got, tt.want)
			}
		})
	}
}
